rule: Rehearsal inputs only. Every entry is an engineering PROPOSAL or a MEASURE_PLACEHOLDER awaiting measurement; none is approved or a production value. The resolver refuses an entry for a value that is already approved.

emergency_max_anchor_age_blocks.basis: One hour; set from measured propagation on staging.

emergency_max_validity_blocks.basis: One hour; set from measured multi-party signing on staging (E03, T02).

handover_max_anchor_age_blocks.basis: One hour, like the emergency anchor age; set from measured propagation on staging.

handover_max_validity_blocks.basis: One hour, like the emergency window; set from measured multi-party signing on staging (E03, T02).

upgrade_max_anchor_age_blocks.basis: One hour, like the emergency anchor age; set from measured propagation on staging.

upgrade_max_validity_blocks.basis: One hour, like the emergency window; set from measured multi-party signing on staging (E03, T02).
